value: unusually large, thick legs and feet
hens often break their own eggs due to bulky legs, so eggs are usually incubated artificially
takes 8 months to a year to reach slaughter weight of 3-5 kg

history_summary.value: A rare Vietnamese breed from Dong Tao village near Hanoi known for its unusually large legs and feet, historically raised exclusively for the royal family and mandarins. It remains a prized, expensive delicacy today, though its bulky legs make natural incubation difficult.
